summary: Store events in SQLite by org
description: Add SqliteEventStore. NFR-01 and FR-C3-08. Every read and write takes org_id. purge_raw_before deletes old raw rows and writes a daily aggregate.
scope: Create the events table without a content column
list_events returns only the requested org
purge_raw_before keeps a daily aggregate and deletes older raw rows
acceptanceCriteria: save then list_events returns the stored row for that org. An org-b row is invisible to list_events('org-a'). purge_raw_before(org, cutoff) removes rows with ts lower than cutoff and list_aggregates shows requests and total_tokens. NFR-01 FR-C3-08.
constraints: Do not query events without an org_id filter.
Do not store user_id or message content.
Do not add HTTP routes in this task.
